How this prediction is made
This is a Parashari reading. Lagna is 23 Aquarius (Kumbha). Chandra lagna is Leo (Purva Phalguni). Houses are
whole-sign. Timing is Vimshottari from the natal Moon. Gochara (transits) of Saturn, Jupiter, and Rahu are used to
time what the dasha already promises. Charak, Braha, Sutton, Levacy, and DiCara are used as method, not as copied
text. Classical death / kings wrath language is read as caution conflict with authority, illness, or a hard ending of a
chapter not as a sentence.
WHERE YOU ARE RIGHT NOW
Mangala mahadasha (28 Aug 2022 27 Aug 2029). Budha antardasha until 21 Feb 2027. Ashtama Shani: Saturn
transiting the 8th from the Moon (Pisces) from April 2025 into 202728. Rahu transiting the lagna (Aquarius). Jupiter
exalted in Cancer, 6th from lagna. This is a year of documents, identity pressure, and hidden tests not a year of
coasting.

Yogas that will actually deliver
Yogakaraka Venus rules the 4th and 9th for Aquarius and sits exalted in the 2nd. Charak and Braha treat this as the
charts royal planet: home, fortune, father/dharma, and money. It did not fully flower in Venus mahadasha
(childhood). It flowers when Venus becomes antardasha inside a kendra-lord dasha that is MarsVenus, July 2027 to
September 2028.
Neecha bhanga of Mercury: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces, but Jupiter lord of that debilitation sits in a kendra
(7th) conjunct the Moon, and Mercury is exalted in navamsa Virgo. Speech, documents, and commerce stumble first,
then complete. That is the signature of the current MarsMercury year.
Exalted vargottama Sun as 7th lord in the 3rd: the spouse and the public name are won by your own effort,
courage, and voice not by sitting still. Jupiter in the 7th (Magha, retrograde) is the marriage yoga: a spouse with
dignity and ancestral weight, often later than the family timetable. Saturn in own sign in the 12th as lagna lord:
foreign residence, hospitals/research/ashram work, and a life that matures in isolation before it is seen.
Raja yoga note (Braha): for Aquarius, Venus conjunct Mars is the classic raja yoga. They are not conjunct here (1st
and 2nd). Do not claim that yoga. The working yoga is Venus as yogakaraka plus Mars as 10th lord in lagna career
through your own body of work, money through Venus.

Kuja dosha: some North-Indian lists count Mars in the 1st as manglik. Levacy records the standard exception: Mars
in Leo or Aquarius does not give Kuja dosha in any house. Use the middle path: do not fear a curse; do respect Marss
4th, 7th, and 8th aspects. The marriage house is heated by aspect, not by a cancelled dosha.
Navamsa (D9) the inner marriage of the chart
D9 lagna Gemini. Sun remains Aries (vargottama, exalted). Moon exalted in Taurus. Mercury exalted in Virgo.
Jupiter in own-sign Pisces. Saturn exalted in Libra. This is a strong navamsa. Vedic prediction reads it as: the second
half of life, and life after a real partnership, is better than the first impression of the rasi. What is delayed is not
denied.

3. Predictions by period (20262032)
Now through 21 February 2027 MarsMercury
Mercury is 5th and 8th lord, debilitated in the 2nd with exalted Venus, cancelled by Jupiter in kendra and by
navamsa exaltation. From Mars (mahadasha lord in lagna) Mercury sits in the 2nd wealth, family, and speech, not a
trika from the MD lord. Charaks favourable MarsMercury list includes learning, commerce, and accomplishment of
undertakings; the adverse list is losses and mental anguish when Mercury is weak. Your Mercury is weak in rasi and
strong in cancellation. Expect: a document, exam, contract, visa, diagnosis, or conversation that looks like a failure
first and a settlement second.
Profession / business: this is the paperwork year of a career that becomes public in 202728. Register, invoice,
trademark, write the offer, sit the interview. Do not wait for MarsVenus to feel ready. Venus spends what Mercury
has already put in writing. Money: 2nd-house activation with Saturn aspecting the 2nd from the 12th and transiting
the 2nd (Saturn in Pisces). Income is real but delayed, taxed, or sent abroad. Save more than you display.
Love / marriage: 8th-lord Mercury does not solemnize; it reveals. Hidden motives in a bond come up. If you are
unmarried, serious talks can start, especially from November 2026 when Jupiter pratyantara runs under Mercury. If
you are married, a money/in-law/intimacy conversation that you have been postponing arrives. Health: nerves, skin,
gut, sleep. Mercury + Ashtama Shani. Do not self-diagnose from fear. Get one real checkup and follow it.

Ketu occupies the 5th (Gemini): romance, speculation, children, and the intelligence that thinks it already knows.
Ketu antardasha under Mars cuts. Charaks adverse MarsKetu list is injury, discord, and professional obstacle. Read
it as: do not start a company, a pregnancy plan, or a wedding in this window if you can wait until Venus. Do end a
false role, a leaking business, or a bond that is already dead. Jupiter enters Leo (your 7th) around January 2027 you
will feel marriage/partnership destiny. Ketus job is to strip the fantasy so Venus can build the real thing. Spiritual
practice, retreat, and surgery of the schedule belong here. High-risk trading does not.
20 July 2027 18 September 2028 MarsVenus (prime window)
This is the period the rest of the Mars dasha is for. Yogakaraka Venus exalted in the 2nd, running inside the
10th-lords mahadasha. Overlap: Jupiter in or repeating through Leo (7th house) in 202728; Saturn leaving ashtama
from the Moon into Aries (9th from Chandra) through 2027, with a brief Pisces dip in early 2028. Relief on the
8th-house pressure; fortune and dharma open.
Marriage / wife: highest-probability window in this decade to marry, or to remake an existing marriage into an adult
contract. Wife indicated: Leo 7th + Magha Jupiter + 7th lord Sun exalted warmth, pride, visible family or
self-respect, not a shrinking partner. Met through work, voice, siblings, or a short decisive journey (Sun in 3rd).
Money / property / vehicles: Venus as 4th and 9th lord in 2nd. House, car, title, or a professional brand that finally
pays. Job / business: public face. Raise, practice, partnership firm, or independent offer. Charak also lists foreign
residence as an adverse Venus result under Mars for this chart that can simply mean living or earning abroad, which
Saturn in the 12th already promises.
DO NOT WASTE MARSVENUS
If you delay the proposal, the rate card, or the move until after Saturn feels better, you will hand the same fruit to Rahu
mahadasha, where it comes with more hunger and less peace. Venus gives the civilized version. Take it.
September 2028 January 2029 MarsSun
Short, hot, and titled. 7th lord exalted and vargottama. If marriage is not sealed in Venus AD, Sun AD can still
crystallize it especially a formal, family-visible, or status-linked bond. Also: father, government, boss, fame,
head/heat in the body. Do not pick a fight with authority for sport. Pick the title.
January August 2029 MarsMoon
Moon sits in the 7th with Jupiter and rules the 6th. Closing the Mars dasha through relationship and work. Good for
public goodwill, poor for leaving a quarrel half-fought. Health: digestion, sleep, blood pressure of the mind. Hand a
clean slate to Rahu.
August 2029 August 2047 Rahu mahadasha
Rahu in the 11th in Mula: the root is torn up so a larger tree can grow. Eighteen years of networks, foreign income,
unconventional status, and appetite. Mula does not let you keep a small life out of politeness. Prediction: the 2030s
are bigger than the 2020s in reach if Mars dasha has already taught you to occupy the lagna without cancelling
yourself. If it has not, Rahu will inflate the same 12th-house disappearance into a public emptiness. First Rahu years

Jupiter into Leo (7th) from early 2027, with a Cancer retrograde dip, then Leo again into 2028. Sutton: Jupiter on
the 7th or opposite lagna/Moon is a classic marriage / happy-partnership transit. It coincides with MarsVenus. That
double clock is why 202728 is not a generic good year. It is the year. Saturn into Aries (9th from Moon) from
mid-2027: fortune, father, dharma, long travel heavier but more meaningful than ashtama. Rahu through lagna
(through 2026 into 2027): do not reinvent your face every month. Pick one name and keep it.
5. Life-area predictions
Health
Lagna with Mars, exalted Sun in the 3rd: pitta. Head, blood, inflammation, haste, then crash. 6th lord Moon in the
7th with Jupiter: gut and mood marry worry becomes digestion. Ashtama Shani (202528): joints, teeth, chronic
low-grade fear, sleep. Jupiter gochara in the 6th now is the antidote if you use it as medicine (routine, doctors, honest
rest) not as I can outwork this. Mars dasha classically can bring surgery or injury when Mars is in lagna not a fate; a
reason to respect tools, roads, and temper. After Saturn leaves the 8th from Moon, vitality returns in a drier, older
form. This is correspondence, not diagnosis.
Love, marriage, wife
7th house Leo occupied by Moon and retrograde Jupiter in Magha. 7th lord Sun exalted in the 3rd, vargottama.
Navamsa Jupiter in own-sign Pisces. The wife (or spouse) is not a quiet helper. She has heat, pride, and a sense of
lineage Maghas throne. She may come from a family that takes itself seriously, or she may carry that seriousness in
herself. Meeting: through your own effort, word, craft, siblings, or a short journey not through waiting. Timing: late
20272028 first, Sun AD late 2028 as second strike. Rahu MD can still marry, but the flavour becomes more foreign,
unusual, or status-hungry.
Friction: Mars aspects the 7th; 6th lord sits in the 7th. Arguments about work, health, and whose will leads. Remedy
is not a gemstone first. Remedy is a partner who can meet force without collapsing, and a physical channel for Mars
so the 7th house does not have to be the battlefield. Retrograde Jupiter: you marry after you have become the teacher
you were looking for.
Family, home, children
4th lord Venus exalted in the 2nd: home, mother, and vehicles are part of the wealth yoga stronger in MarsVenus
than they were in youth. Mars aspects the 4th: heat in the house, renovation, or a home that is also a workshop.
Lagna lord in the 12th: distance from the birthplace is a feature, not a failure. Ketu in the 5th: children delayed, few,
or spiritually marked; romance that refuses the ordinary script. Do not force a 5th-house outcome in MarsKetu.
Venus AD and Jupiter in the 7th are kinder for family expansion if that is desired.
Profession, job, business, wealth

10th lord Mars in lagna in his own mahadasha is the career prediction: you are not waiting to be chosen. Technical,
surgical, engineering, military-adjacent, sports, surgery of systems, investigation, independent practice, or any work
where your name is the product. Ashwini Sun in the 3rd adds healer, initiator, communicator. 2nd house
VenusMercury: money through voice, counsel, design, medicine-adjacent speech, or trade. 11th Rahu: the scaled
version is foreign, digital, or networked. 10th from Moon is Taurus Venus again so Chandra-lagna career also pays
when Venus is running.
Job versus business: employment works if it has a path to command (Mars in lagna will not stay the unnamed
technician). Business works as a practice with Saturns accounts. Partnership business is promised (Jupiter 2nd/11th
lord in 7th) but pick a partner in Venus AD, not in Ketu AD. Wealth is delayed by Saturns aspect on the 2nd, then
durable. Peak cash-and-name: 202728, then Rahus 2030s.
6. Precautions and upay (practical, not magical thinking)
Ashtama Shani through early 2028: no reckless debt, no secret health neglect, no Ill sleep when the dasha ends. Rahu
on lagna: no impulsive surgery, tattoo of identity, or emigration on a mood. Mars dasha: respect fire, metal, vehicles,
and anger. Mercury AD: every important yes in writing, 72 hours later. Ketu AD 2027: endings only. Venus AD: say
the yes you have been rehearsing since 2022.
Classical upay that matches this chart without superstition-as-substitute: strengthen the body (Mars) on a fixed
schedule; keep accounts (Saturn in 12th); tell the truth in documents (Mercury neecha bhanga); donate or serve on
Thursdays when you ask Jupiter in the 7th for a spouse worth Magha; do not buy a yellow sapphire to get married
while ignoring the calendar. The calendar is the remedy.
7. The prediction in one page
2026early 2027 is the year of the contract and the test. Mid-2027 is the cut. Late 2027 through 2028 is the harvest of
Mars dasha: marriage or its adult equivalent, money with a name on it, a visible craft. 2029 hands the baton to Rahu,
who will make the life larger and less polite. The wife, when she comes, will not be small. The work, if you claim
the 10th lord in lagna, will not be invisible. The only prediction that fails is the one where you cancel the impulse
after you already know which is not a graha. That is the 12th-house habit of a strong Saturn, and it is optional.
SOURCES AND METHOD
Positions: Swiss Ephemeris 2.10, Lahiri. Whole-sign houses from 23 Aquarius. Vimshottari from Purva Phalguni
Moon (Venus remainder 14.38y at birth). Interpretive method paraphrased from Charak (dasha/antardasha,
yogakaraka), Braha (Aquarius raja yoga rules), Sutton (Jupiter gochara), Levacy (Kuja exceptions), DiCara
(nakshatra). Not medical, legal, or financial advice.
